brief: ANIMAL-001 r001 cattle and sheep (first livestock kit) — DRAFT brief in content/research/next-batch/settlement-features.md section 6 (proposal, not a frozen pack), per-candidate notes section 3, README.md; executed under art/handoffs/bronze-bohemia-opus-v2 COMMON.md / RETURN.md as a batch-3 kit job
author: GitHub Copilot autonomous modelling agent for the Bronze Bohemia project (procedural generator written for this job)
actual_agent_model: Dispatched as the 'Opus 5.5' modeller slot (GitHub Copilot agent session); the underlying model identity cannot be independently verified from inside the session
tools: Blender 5.2.3 LTS (bpy generator, Workbench stills, re-import/contact check)
Khronos glTF Blender I/O v5.2.41 (GLB export/import)
Godot Engine 4.5.1.stable.official.f62fdbde1 (headless import checks; GPU viewport captures with the Compatibility renderer, gl_compatibility on Apple M1 Pro, OpenGL 4.1 Metal-90.5)
Python 3.9.6 + numpy 1.26.4 (independent GLB parser and skinning) + Pillow 11.3.0 (sheets)
origin: floor point between the four hooves (0,0,0); scene root node identity
physical_dimensions_note: No measured source exists: animal bones did not survive at Brezice (S22 p. 12); every size is an R design envelope from the draft brief.

models.role: small generic short-horned cow (R), rigged, six in-place clips; origin on the floor between the hooves, +Z front

textures.name: animal_atlas
textures.role: base colour only (sRGB), shared kit atlas

models.export_bounds_note: rest/bind pose from the POSITION accessor; animated envelopes per clip are in checks/glb_inspect.json (animated_bounds_m)

skeleton.naming: shared quadruped scheme: root (non-deforming, never animated), pelvis, spine1, spine2, neck, head, tail1, tail2, leg_{FL,FR,HL,HR}_{1,2,3}; F/H = front/hind, L/R = animal's left (+X) / right (-X), 1/2/3 = upper/middle/lower (3 carries the hoof); no jaw bone

anchor_notes.base_center: exported node on the root (identity, floor point between the hooves)
anchor_notes.head_lead: exported node on bone 'head' at the throat/cheek (halter/rope attachment point); Godot imports it as Skeleton3D/head (BoneAttachment3D)/head_lead; world rotation is identity at rest

animations.name: idle
animations.behaviour: standing; weight sway, two breaths, slow head turn, tail swish; all four hooves planted

animations.name: walk
animations.behaviour: in-place lateral-sequence walk (HL, FL, HR, FR at 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75 of a cycle), duty 0.64 cattle / 0.62 sheep; cattle 1 stride cycle per loop (stride 0.8 m), sheep 2 cycles per loop (stride 0.4 m); planted hooves move back at the authored ground speed

animations.name: graze
animations.behaviour: head down to the floor (muzzle 12 mm cattle / 10 mm sheep above y=0 at its lowest), two nibble/tear cycles, slow head sweep; hooves planted

animations.name: lie_idle
animations.behaviour: sternal lying, legs folded (hind legs to the sides), breathing, slow head turn, small rumination nod

animations.name: lie_down
animations.behaviour: stand -> head lowered -> front carpi (knees) to the floor while hind legs stay planted -> hindquarters fold down -> sternal lying; ends on lie_idle frame 0

animations.name: stand_up
animations.behaviour: lying -> head lunge -> hindquarters rise first (front still kneeling) -> front legs unfold -> standing; ends on idle frame 0

coat_variants.selection: same GLB + same atlas; set StandardMaterial3D.uv1_offset = (0.25 * k, 0, 0) on a duplicate of the imported material (k = 0..3)

kit_unique_textures.layout: 4 coat columns x 128 px; rows 0-255 cattle, 256-511 sheep; per species: 160-row coat gradient (back -> belly) + four 32 px detail cells (points, dark hoof/nose/eye, horn or inner ear, muzzle)

herd_demo_4_cattle_8_sheep.note: each demo instance duplicates the material only to set a coat uv1_offset; a game could share 4+4 material instances

reference_note: No reference image was adopted for animals (settlement-features.md section 3: no freely licensed Bohemian LBA faunal image or verified ancient-breed reference). No MC/SF picture is relevant to this job; none was used for shape or texture.
parts_and_uncertainties: E (negative, S22 p. 12): no animal bones survive at Brezice; any animal there is a regional R
E (regional, KY16 as cited in settlement-features.md): cattle usually dominant, sheep commoner than goats; species choice only
R: body size, proportions, horn form and length, polled sheep, short tail, fleece look, coat colours, coat-variant set
R: gait timing, stride, duty factor, walking speed 0.8 m/s, lying/rising sequence (front knees first down, hind first up), grazing posture
R: herd composition and layout in the demo (4 cattle + 8 sheep), PERSON placement
F: none in the models; demo placement only
own_work_license: Unselected original project work; manager/owner decision
deviations: Draft brief, not a frozen v3 pack: executed under the opus-v2 COMMON/RETURN contract; repo intake tool does not know the ID, so independent measurements are supplied in checks/ instead
FENCE-001 pen not available (not returned in this batch) - herd demo has no pen
No jaw bone ('jaw?' optional in the brief); grazing/rumination use head motion only
Sheep walk loop holds two stride cycles (1 s loop) to keep a 0.8 m/s authored speed with sheep-sized strides
Preview sun uses shadow_bias 0.2 / normal_bias 4.0 (Godot defaults 0.1 / 2.0 gave self-shadow acne on the broad cattle back at close range); renderer setting, not part of the asset
